title: Jones, Little & Co., CPAs, LLP
description: About Jones, Little & Co., CPAs, LLP Jones, Little & Co., CPAs, LLP is a professional accounting firm that offers a wide range of services including business accounting, tax preparation, and IRS problem resolution. They cater to small businesses, non-profit organizations, and specialized industries such as auto dealers and retailers. At least 100 gigabytes of company data—including financial records, internal files, and employee personal information—were stolen in a cyberattack. Hackers encrypted the firm's systems after exfiltrating the documents, leaving operations paralyzed.
